text:
Maya: Quick sync for the Thursday docs push. Items: embedding example in migration needs update, one broken internal link from guides -> migration path, and a tiny SDK rename (jsClient -> client). Can someone own snippets and relnotes wording?

Jun: I can take the snippet fix. Current failing example in tests: `await jsClient.embed('hi')` -> 400. Replacement: `await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'hi' })`. I'll open PR and include JS + Python minimal examples.

Rafael: I'll handle the redirect for the moved anchor. CI LinkCheck flagged guides/migration/embedding.md#legacy which should point to migration/embedding-v2.md#legacy-embeddings. I'll add _redirects.yaml entry and update the link in the page.

Maya: Draft relnotes bullet: "Embeddings: SDK method signatures changed; update client usage. See Embeddings migration guide for examples and quick diff." Short and clear?

Jun: Works. I'll add a one-line diff in the migration guide and keep relnotes terse.

docs-bot: Link Scanner: 1 broken anchor found (guides/migration/embedding.md#legacy).

Maya: Plan: Jun opens snippet PR, Rafael opens redirect PR. We aim to merge both by Wed EOD so redirect is included in Thurs deploy. I'll post relnotes draft in thread for quick signoff once PRs are up.

Jun: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2002 (includes snippets + changelog line).

Rafael: Redirect PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2003. Tagging infra for fast review.

Maya: Thanks — ping me when merged and I'll finalize relnotes and post for approval. Reminder: run `make linkcheck` locally to catch any remaining anchors. :thumbsup:
